source.title: Consortium Magi's Cuffs — Wowhead item page
source.author: 13rahma (commenter)

quote: This apparently cannot be sold to a vendor and cannot be disenchanted
notes: One firsthand comment states the renown-vendor cuffs could not be disenchanted or vendored; Wowhead Quick Facts does not independently display the no-disenchant flag. Historical/individual report, without character build, item version, acquisition/refund state, or date; NOT proven universal non-DE eligibility. Item appeared in patch 11.2.0. DB2Restrictions.lua already references this ID; this adds a distinct citation to v3 research only, not a new engine restriction. Do not interpret failure as measured zero material yield.
